metadata.title: Urban Mixtape Graphic with Textured Block Lettering

retrievalProfile.description: A high-impact urban layout featuring heavy, multi-textured block lettering set against a dark, geometric pyramid-patterned background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, centered typographic composition where large, heavy-weight block letters are filled with individual textures and gradients, layered over a black repeating 3D pyramid grid.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between vibrant, multi-colored text and dark textured background
Vertical stacking of three distinct typographic tiers
Repetition of geometric pyramid shapes creating a tactile surface effect
Individual letter-level texture variation within a unified blocky silhouette
coreInvariants: Multi-colored gradient fills within the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally aligned, occupying approximately 80% of the frame width with three stacked horizontal rows.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, multi-colored block letters in the top two rows.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical scan, starting with the largest textured letters and moving to the smaller, sharper geometric text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily consisting of the dark textured background visible between letter gaps and margins.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and Silver (secondary text and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multi-color spectrum (Red, Yellow, Blue, Orange, Green) within letter fills
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the primary text accents against a low-value, high-contrast black background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high-contrast metallic or vibrant fills for text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold geometric sans-serif and stencil-like block forms
letterConstructionRules: Primary letters use thick, rectangular strokes with minimal internal counters
Bottom tier uses sharp, 45-degree angular cuts and stencil gaps
Heavy 3D beveling and drop shadows applied to all characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the middle row feature internal mesh-like textures
Bottom row characters are constructed from segmented geometric blocks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking heavy, textured display type with sharper, stencil-style geometric type for an industrial urban look.
graphicDevices: Small circular icons/pips between text lines

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the primary display text.
Matches the angular, segmented look of the bottom tier text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, matte black background consisting of a repeating grid of small 3D pyramids with subtle top-down lighting to create highlights on the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply three rows of centered, heavy block lettering. The top two rows should have individual textures (brushed metal, mesh, gradients) per letter. The bottom row should be a sharp, yellow-to-white gradient stencil font.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent 3D pyramid grid?
Are the letters heavy, blocky, and beveled?
Is there a clear vertical hierarchy of three text rows?
Do the top letters feature varied internal textures?

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting on the pyramid background
Ensure text beveling is sharp and not muddy
Verify that the multi-color fills are vibrant
Confirm the stencil gaps in the bottom row are clean
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark geometric 3D pattern background with stacked, ultra-bold, multi-textured display typography for an aggressive urban aesthetic.
